morbi.headline: Morbi ceramics see relief in freight and fuel costs amid broader export pressures.
what_changed: Morbi ceramic units reduced PNG consumption in favor of improved propane availability.
Ocean container freight rates for Morbi ceramic exports dropped by up to 50 percent.
Somany Ceramics announced a 5 MSM capacity increase via debottlenecking.
stress_signals: Indian ceramic tile industry faces ongoing export market challenges and rising production cost pressures [895aa138960b].
improvement_signals: Propane supply improvements allowed Morbi units to cut higher-cost PNG consumption [81469af468f3].
Container freight rates dropped up to 50 percent, reducing export shipping overheads [d6c30857de2c].
what_to_watch: Sustainability of propane price advantages versus PNG and impact on working capital margins.
Export volume recovery across major overseas destinations following the 50% freight rate reduction.
Execution details of Somany Ceramics' 5 MSM debottlenecking, including capital expenditure and OEM reliance [0f642d309dd8].

surat.headline: Surat cluster shows recovering diamond demand and policy push, alongside textile fraud and demand divergence.
what_changed: Surat Textile Policy approved 627 units with Rs 1,521 crore investment [021c037e28d9].
Diamond cutting and polishing units plan early reopening after vacations due to improving demand [bd78e4a130ff].
MANTRA expanded into MedTech by launching medical textile testing services in Surat [5e7cd22236e9].
stress_signals: SGCCI sought GUJCTOC against organized gangs committing textile fraud and payment defaults [421d4bf835f5].
Ahmedabad traders arrested for defrauding Surat textile merchants of over Rs 22 lakh [f699b1f05b5e].
Diamond units faced pre-Diwali closures due to rough diamond shortages despite demand revival [b65b93c4b724].
improvement_signals: Diamond trade witnessed a return of vibrancy following a four-year recession [bae3b8d48691].
SGCCI signed two MoUs in Morocco to boost Surat textile exports [472a28abf217].
what_to_watch: Implementation of the Textile Ministry capacity database drive for fabric output tracking [5177389da7be].
Resolution of payment defaults and enforcement actions against textile fraud gangs [421d4bf835f5].
Rough diamond supply constraints impacting cutting and polishing unit operations [b65b93c4b724].
